goal: Stop malformed JSON-RPC batch elements from inheriting earlier request IDs in error replies
Prevent invalid batch element errors from being dropped when preceded by a notification
agreement: Support for fixing JSON-RPC specification compliance for batch responses (pinheadmz)
Verified by testing that the fix resolves the bug (janb84, AndreaDiazCorreia)
Suggests creating fresh request objects per batch element instead of resetting fields (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case bug where invalid batch elements inherit earlier request IDs
Resolves a JSON-RPC specification violation for API consumers expecting unique response IDs
Impact is limited because it only affects malformed non-object batch elements
